beats.vo: Sleeping with contact lenses? STOP doing this.
beats.caption: SLEEPING IN LENSES? STOP
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: Sleeping with contact lenses? STOP doing this.

beats.vo: This can damage your eye overnight.
beats.caption: DAMAGE STARTS OVERNIGHT
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: This can damage your eye overnight.

beats.vo: When you sleep in lenses, oxygen supply to your cornea drops. The cornea swells. Bacteria grow.
beats.caption: OXYGEN BLOCKED
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: When you sleep in lenses, oxygen supply to your cornea drops. The cornea swells. Bacteria grow.

beats.vo: This can lead to infections, ulcers. Even vision loss.
beats.caption: EVEN VISION LOSS
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: This can lead to infections, ulcers. Even vision loss.

beats.vo: Always remove lenses before sleep. No exceptions.
beats.caption: REMOVE. EVERY NIGHT.
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: Always remove lenses before sleep. No exceptions.

beats.vo: Save this. Most people don't know this.
beats.caption: SAVE THIS
beats.speaker: RAVI
beats.voText: Save this. Most people don't know this.
